next.reason: 1985: "The AT END phrase must be specified if no applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is specified for file-name-1."; 2023: "If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement.". 2023 READ syntax rules no longer require AT END. A READ with neither AT END nor an applicable USE, refused in 1985, is now accepted, and 2023 defines its execution.
